description: Operational knobs selected by the GPU a stage runs on (natlang_neuralese/train/hardware_profile.py; plans/COREWEAVE_HARDWARE_OPTIMIZATION.md). Only execution choices that are recipe-operational (checkpoint_layers, window_execution) and execution environment switches; training math stays in the shared recipes. Matched in order; NATLANG_HARDWARE_PROFILE=<name>|none overrides. A profile with empty stage_parameters runs the recipe unchanged. Values marked pending are decided by the first sandbox's hw_bench result (runs/coreweave-hw-bench/<date>/hw-bench.json) and land here with that evidence.

profiles.name: dgx-gb10
profiles.status: baseline: the recipes and kernels were tuned here (plans/neuralese/TRAINING_SPEED_20261012.md); nothing to override

profiles.name: rtx-pro-6000-blackwell
profiles.status: provisional until the first hw_bench run: allocator setting only. Pending from the bench: neuralese_direct.checkpoint_layers (Mellum stays checkpointed: ~9.5 MB/token uncheckpointed does not fit 96 GB at 27k tokens; LFM's auto planner already drops checkpointing when it fits), window_execution for LFM (packed vs sequential), NATLANG_MAPLE_COMPILE

train-mellum.reason: the 47 GB checkpoint.pt is loaded with map_location=cpu (plus the 23 GB model safetensors read once) and saved from host copies; 160Gi covers load plus a save in flight. Dataloading is in-process tokenized JSONL: 16 cores leave headroom for the inductor/Triton compile workers and the bundle publisher. Re-size from the bench's host peak (hw-bench.json host_peak_gb)

train-lfm.reason: 350M parameters: checkpoints are a few GB; the union text data is read once

eval.reason: task-success eval: node workers plus model load (scripts/coreweave/jobs/heldv2-base-mellum.json)

teacher.reason: vLLM: weights are staged through host memory at load; tokenization and the API server use a few cores; prefix-cache CPU offload is off

bench.reason: the hw_bench matrix loads the full Mellum (23 GB) once per arm through host memory
